integrity: A complete combinatorial proof and executable finite corroboration are supplied; no human or external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem requires no isolated vertices, order at least five and super domination number at least order minus two. The two-deletion graph of an arbitrary input must be computed; no faster algorithm for arbitrary graphs is claimed. The independently indexed multipartite super domination classification gives the special-case deletion pairs, which are credited; unindexed equivalent research could exist. Independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
title: A triangle criterion and exact optimal-partition census for super coalitions near maximal super domination
